title: Ukulala Kwezikhathi Ezivamile
intro: Usuzoqala uhambo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlangana nemfihlakalo ejulile yokholo namandla aphezulu. Cabanga ngeqembu labantu abaphikisana nezindinganiso zomphakathi wabo, bebambelele ekukholweni kukaNkulunkulu oyedwa ezweni lokukhulekela onkulunkulu abaningi. Indaba yabo iwubufakazi bekhono lika-Allah lokuvikela izinceku zaKhe ezilungile ngezindlela ezingavamile kakhulu. Ungakwazi yini ukuhlukanisa ukuthi bangobani laba bantu abaphawulekayo?
clues: Sasiyiqembu elincane lezinsizwa ezazikholelwa kuNkulunkulu oyedwa, naphezu kobuningi babantu bakithi.
Sabalekela umbusi ononya owayesisongela ngenxa yokholo lwethu, esaba ukushushiswa nokufa.
Safuna indawo yokukhosela endaweni engasese, sinethemba lomusa nesivikelo sika-Allah kubacindezeli bethu.
INkosi yethu yasenza salala ubuthongo obukhulu, ubuthongo obumangalisayo obungamelana nokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Lapho sivuka, sasikholelwa ukuthi siphumule usuku noma ingxenye yosuku kuphela, singazi isikhathi eside esasidlulile ngempela.
I-Quran ikhuluma ngokuthi sahlala kulesi simo iminyaka engamakhulu amathathu, sadlula ngeyisishiyagalolunye, saba uphawu kubantu.
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (Al-Kahf 18:25)
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
